# Multi-clip test sources

All clips are Creative Commons. They are trimmed to about 12 seconds for the suite.

| Id | Source | License | Why it is here |
|----|--------|---------|----------------|
| acoustic_chords | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Guitare_accoustique_accords.ogg | CC BY-SA 2.5 | Solo acoustic guitar |
| electric_lick | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Electric_guitar_lick_in_the_style_of_Chuck_Berry.wav | CC BY-SA 4.0 | Short electric guitar |
| acoustic_shuffle | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:AcousticShuffle.ogg | CC BY-SA 3.0 | Guitar plus bass (mixed band) |
| guitar_tune | https://opengameart.org/content/guitar-tune | CC0 | Short plucked guitar melody |

## Eval fixtures (`tests/fixtures/eval/`)

Synthetic CC0 clips generated by `python -m tests.eval.synthesize` / `tests.eval.run_baseline`:

| File | What it is |
|------|------------|
| `clean_melody.wav` | 7-note dry harmonic plucks with known MIDI times |
| `distorted_melody.wav` | Same lick with tanh overdrive |
| `distorted_bleed_melody.wav` | Distorted lick + kick/snare impulses every 0.5 s |
| `band_mix.wav` | Distorted lick + drums + bass (same 7-note guitar truth) |
| `drums_only.wav` | Kick/snare impulses used by evidence-score tests |
| `bass_only.wav` | Low E/A pulses under the band mix |
| `ground_truth.json` | Note start / duration / MIDI for mir-eval scoring |

These are the quantitative accuracy regression fixtures (see `tests/eval/BASELINE.md`).

Hand-curated (thinned Basic Pitch draft) MIDI labels:

| File | Clip |
|------|------|
| `labels/electric_lick.json` | Solo electric lick |
| `labels/acoustic_chords.json` | Solo acoustic chords |
| `labels/acoustic_shuffle.json` | Guitar plus bass mix |

Labels are **Balanced** Basic Pitch drafts of those public clips. They are a smoke lock, not independent human transcriptions. Real-audio accuracy uses GuitarSet via `python -m tests.eval.run_guitarset`.

`band_mix.wav` is a synthetic distorted lick plus drums and bass with the same 7-note guitar ground truth.
